fixture_set: satellite element sets with traceable provenance

files.contents: three element sets in CelesTrak's 3-line format (name padded to 24 characters, then the two TLE lines): ISS (ZARYA) epoch 2019-12-09 (the TLE printed in README.rst; the name comes from the export_omm call next to it), VANGUARD 1 epoch 2020 (VANGUARD_TLE in sgp4/tests.py) and MARIO epoch 2023 (MARIO_TLE in sgp4/tests.py; the test file says it was taken from CelesTrak's stations.txt)

the OMM field listing that README.rst prints for the same ISS element set (the output of python-sgp4's export_omm, not a CelesTrak download), with every value checked against the README text; includes extra fields (CENTER_NAME, REF_FRAME, ...) a parser must ignore

notes: No data was downloaded from CelesTrak for these fixtures: CelesTrak is not reachable from the build sandbox. The first live run of sat_ingest will be the first contact with the real service.
A TLE's checksum digit is part of each line; these lines were copied as published upstream.
